text: You have power over an enemy. Right now. What do you do?
name: en-US-ChristopherNeural

text: One was a duke in Renaissance Italy. He trusted an enemy he had wronged... and it ruined him.
name: en-US-ChristopherNeural

text: The other was a warrior in one of Rumi's stories. His beaten enemy insulted him... and what he did next won something no battle could give him.
name: en-US-ChristopherNeural

text: Today, Machiavelli and Rumi answer one of the oldest questions there is. What do you do... with an enemy?
name: en-US-ChristopherNeural

text: Machiavelli explains it in one line. For men injure either from fear or hatred.
name: en-US-ChristopherNeural

text: Someone you once hurt... may still resent you, or fear you. And resentment, handed power, tends to strike first.
name: en-US-ChristopherNeural

text: But as Whinfield's translation tells it... Ali, instead of taking vengeance on him, at once dropped his sword... to the Magian's great astonishment.
name: en-US-ChristopherNeural

text: In essence, Ali's answer is this. He fought for something higher than himself... not for his own pride.
name: en-US-ChristopherNeural

text: At first, they sound like opposites. Machiavelli says, never assume an old injury is forgotten. Rumi says, drop the sword.
name: en-US-ChristopherNeural

text: Next time someone pokes at you, wait one breath. Is this my move... or theirs?
name: en-US-ChristopherNeural

text: Follow Awaaz... for the full story.
name: en-US-ChristopherNeural

text: In a story by Rumi, Ali is winning a fight against an enemy chief.
name: en-US-ChristopherNeural

text: Then the beaten man spits in Ali's face.
name: en-US-ChristopherNeural

text: As Whinfield's translation tells it. Ali, instead of taking vengeance on him, at once dropped his sword... to the Magian's great astonishment.
name: en-US-ChristopherNeural

text: That spit was the enemy's last weapon. He couldn't win the fight... so he tried to win Ali's temper.
name: en-US-ChristopherNeural

text: When a rival sends you a message built to sting... the angry reply is exactly the move they were hoping you'd make.
name: en-US-ChristopherNeural
